name: Crest Palace / Temple of Heavenly Light
description: Insect Princess Radachne has Earth, Light, and Dark Killer. She starts the battle with Wyrm's Shell that negates a set amount of DMG and returns when she loses enough HP. Also, if she is not defeated within a set time after she uses Arts, she will call Wyrms that inflict Status Ailments according to their Element.

name: Crest Palace / Shrine of Oblivion
description: Oldeus, the Burier has Light Killer and cancels DMG negation. He appears with a fog that nullifies all DMG until he enters Break status, and it returns when he loses enough HP. His Dark resistance weakens Dark-Element attacks.

name: Crest Palace / Shrine of Aberration
description: Ferocious Plant Beast Gorondola's attacks have a chance of Poisoning units. It appears with underlings that defend it from all DMG and spawns more after losing enough HP.

name: Crest Palace / Shrine of the Azul Knight
description: Palamicia, the Silent Divine has Human and God Killer. Her CRI Negation prevents CRI attacks.

name: Crest Palace / Shrine of the Burning Chains
description: Inferno God Ifrit has Spirit and Machine Killer. While he is Burning, his attack speed will increase and he will gain Water resistance. Extinguish him to lower his Water resistance and action speed.

name: Crest Palace / Shrine of Adamantine
description: Radiant Dragon Fosradius has Fire, Water, and Earth Killer. He will enter Rage Mode after losing enough HP, reducing the DMG of everything but Dark attacks. When not in Rage Mode, the DMG of everything but Light attacks will be reduced.

name: Crest Palace / Shrine of Whirlwind
description: Demon Beast Belgiras can only be hurt while Poisoned. It also has high Break resistance and will sometimes call reinforcements. Defeat them to gain lots of BE.

name: Crest Palace / Shrine of Discordia
description: Subject β-3 will immediately use Mad Predator which boosts its resistance to all Elements and Accuracy. After losing enough HP, it will boost its action speed and DMG.

name: Crest Palace / Shrine of Crimson Sea
description: Flame Spirit Ignis will activate the Hellfire field effect which deals continuous DMG and reflective DMG. It also has high Fire resistance.

name: Crest Palace / Shrine of Diamond Dust
description: Azure Phoenix Freydal has resistance to Seal, Freeze, and Paralyze. During Storm Mode, its Accuracy and Arts DMG will be boosted, and it will nullify Break DMG.

name: Crest Palace / Shrine of Eternity
description: Verdant Dragon Elpneumas can regenerate its HP. Though it nullifies Water attacks and is resistant to Magic attacks, Burning will cause it to take more DMG. When it uses Arts, it calls Dark Corocs as reinforcements.

name: Crest Palace / Shrine of Cursed Claw
description: Subject γ-2 has God and Demon Killer. It is also resistance to Arts gauge reduction and enters Rage Mode after losing enough HP. It takes more Break DMG from Fire units, and repeated Breaks will weaken its defenses. The Blue Skeletons that appear with it can inflict Disease.

name: Crest Palace / Shrine of Perdition
description: Blightwing Valzandeth is resistant to Arts gauge reduction and CRI attacks. Its Roar of Ruin Arts will call reinforcements: Grangarrods which can reduce Paralyze resistance but weakened while Burning, and Cyclopes which can reduce Arts gauges but weakened while Blinded.

name: Shrine of Tribulation
description: Za'remnah has God Killer and CRI resistance. His Phantasm Lock Arts will focus on the three rightmost units. Locked units cannot move, but it will be canceled when he enters Break status. He also takes increased DMG during Break.

name: Crest Palace / Shrine of Caliginosity
description: Regulus takes little DMG at first but weakens with each Break. Feena has Demon Killer and Arts that cancels DMG Negation. Celia's "Prophecy" reduces HP Recovery amount each time she uses it. When her HP reaches 50%, she will switch to "Endless" for Non-Elemental DMG with a high CRI rate. At 0% HP, she will end with "Apocalypse" that deals Dark DMG at a high CRI rate.
